granularity_note: minute bars do not exist on this machine, so a 30m book is marked from the latest DAILY bar. The pass says so rather than implying a resolution it does not have; lane D (chunk 5b) builds the intraday mark.
selector: decide_weights -- run_one is backtest-only (it requires a Window and every registered engine replays one), so a live decision uses the faithful selector and REFUSES any signal or weighting it cannot compute
